AirQualityObserved.description: One air-quality station of Barcelona and its hourly means.

address.description: Where the station stands, as the city describes it (Smart Data Models' common PostalAddress).

areaServed.description: The neighbourhood (barri) the station or well is in, as the city names it.

blackCarbon.description: Black carbon, the hour's mean at the station. A property of this model: the Smart Data Model AirQualityObserved names no black carbon attribute. The city's file gives it in ng/m³ under a µg/m³ label; the pipeline divides by 1000.

co.description: Carbon monoxide, the hour's mean at the station, in mg/m³ as the city measures it.

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for.

dateObserved.description: The end of the period the entity's newest readings cover, UTC: the hour of an air-quality mean, the local day of a weather station's values, the day of a well's reading.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

name.description: The name, per language, as the city publishes it (Catalan for the stations).

no.description: Nitrogen monoxide, the hour's mean at the station.

no2.description: Nitrogen dioxide, the hour's mean at the station.

nox.description: Nitrogen oxides (NO + NO2 as NO2), the hour's mean at the station.

o3.description: Ozone, the hour's mean at the station.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

pm10.description: Particulate matter up to 10 µm, the hour's mean at the station.

pm25.description: Particulate matter up to 2.5 µm, the hour's mean at the station.

so2.description: Sulphur dioxide, the hour's mean at the station.

source.description: The open-data file the entity was read from.

stationCode.description: The station's code in the network that runs it: the Catalan air-quality network (XVPCA, the city's codi_eoi, such as `8019043`), the Meteocat weather network (such as `D5`) or the Catalan water agency's well register (ACA, such as `08019-0148`).

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

PhreaticObserved.description: One piezometer or well of Barcelona and its newest groundwater reading.

address.description: Where the station stands, as the city describes it (Smart Data Models' common PostalAddress).

aquifer.description: The groundwater body (massa d'aigua) the well reaches, as the water agency names it.

areaServed.description: The neighbourhood (barri) the station or well is in, as the city names it.

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for.

dateObserved.description: The end of the period the entity's newest readings cover, UTC: the hour of an air-quality mean, the local day of a weather station's values, the day of a well's reading.

investigationDepth.description: The depth of the well or piezometer in metres. A fixed property of the well, written without a unit code so its rows are never read as a measurement stamped on receipt.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

measurementType.description: What the well's readings measure; `depth` for each of the city's wells.

name.description: The name, per language, as the city publishes it (Catalan for the stations).

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

piezometricLevel.description: The height of the water above sea level at the newest reading (below 0 where the sea draws the aquifer down). A property of this model: PhreaticObserved has only the depth.

source.description: The open-data file the entity was read from.

stationCode.description: The station's code in the network that runs it: the Catalan air-quality network (XVPCA, the city's codi_eoi, such as `8019043`), the Meteocat weather network (such as `D5`) or the Catalan water agency's well register (ACA, such as `08019-0148`).

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

waterTable.description: The depth from the surface to the water in the well at the newest reading.

PostalAddress.description: The value of `address`: a postal address, never an entity of its own (Smart Data Models' common schema).

addressCountry.description: The country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

district.description: The city district (districte) the station is in.

streetAddress.description: The square, park or street corner of the station.

WeatherObserved.description: One Meteocat weather station in Barcelona and its newest day's values.

address.description: Where the station stands, as the city describes it (Smart Data Models' common PostalAddress).

altitude.description: The station's height above sea level in metres, as the weather service lists it. A fixed property of the station, written without a unit code so its rows are never read as a measurement stamped on receipt.

areaServed.description: The neighbourhood (barri) the station or well is in, as the city names it.

atmosphericPressure.description: The day's mean air pressure at the station's height (not reduced to sea level).

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for.

dateObserved.description: The end of the period the entity's newest readings cover, UTC: the hour of an air-quality mean, the local day of a weather station's values, the day of a well's reading.

gustSpeed.description: The day's strongest gust at 10 m.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

maxTemperature.description: The day's highest air temperature at the station. A property of this model: the Smart Data Model WeatherObserved names only the mean.

minTemperature.description: The day's lowest air temperature at the station. A property of this model: the Smart Data Model WeatherObserved names only the mean.

name.description: The name, per language, as the city publishes it (Catalan for the stations).

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

precipitation.description: The day's precipitation, in millimetres (litres per square metre).

relativeHumidity.description: The day's mean relative humidity, as a fraction (0.57 is 57 %).

solarRadiation.description: The day's mean global solar irradiance: the day's irradiation the city gives in MJ/m², times 10^6 / 86400.

source.description: The open-data file the entity was read from.

stationCode.description: The station's code in the network that runs it: the Catalan air-quality network (XVPCA, the city's codi_eoi, such as `8019043`), the Meteocat weather network (such as `D5`) or the Catalan water agency's well register (ACA, such as `08019-0148`).

temperature.description: The day's mean air temperature at the station.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

windDirection.description: The day's mean wind direction at 10 m, in degrees from north.

windSpeed.description: The day's mean wind speed at 10 m.
